summary: Build stronger judgment with scenarios, expert elicitation, and decision analysis. Train your team to decide with confidence under uncertainty.
lede: Decision-making under uncertainty is a disciplined way to frame ambiguity, weigh evidence, compare scenarios, and choose a course of action when data, assumptions, or stakeholder views are incomplete. This course introduces the Classical Model, Structured Expert Judgment, scenario planning, and decision analysis to help you explain why one option was selected under constrained conditions. Through practical exercises, you will build uncertainty matrices, elicitation guides, scenario trees, trade-off tables, scenario logs, and recommendation briefs. You will learn to assess evidence quality, apply probability reasoning, manage bias, evaluate trade-offs, and document decision logic that can withstand scrutiny, audit, and executive challenge.
audienceIntro: This advanced Decision-Making Under Uncertainty Training is built for professionals who must make high-stakes choices with incomplete evidence, competing assumptions, and executive scrutiny. It is especially relevant when you need to frame uncertainty, compare scenarios, and justify a recommendation using structured methods rather than intuition alone.
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience in planning, analysis, operations, risk, policy, finance, or strategy roles. Basic familiarity with probability, statistics, spreadsheets, and structured business reporting is helpful, and no programming is required. Advanced concepts are taught at an operational level, with hands-on use of decision matrices, scenario tools, and structured expert judgment templates.
